Handle.description:
A board's handle: its columns, and the adaptations that settle it.

The config key `try` fills `try_`:

>>> Handle.model_validate({"try": {"host": ["a", "b"]}}).try_
{'host': ('a', 'b')}

columns.description: The store columns naming the board; `handle` alone holds a handle of several parts, `sep`-joined (a hit carries it as a tuple)

sep.title: Sep

follow.description: A part that is the redirect target of its URL template, or of the first of several that answers 200 (a root that refuses a client, then a known path); settled once per handle

prelude.description: Requests answering parts a listing or detail request needs (a token its own page or API hands out), each part settled once per handle and again, once, when a request is refused 401 or 403
